title: Prediction & Retrieval Strategies
summary: This module encompasses advanced strategies for generating predictions, including agentic behaviors, iterative refinement, and code execution. It also provides diverse retrieval mechanisms for fetching relevant information and essential utilities for text processing and configuration management.

nodes.label: Prediction Modules
nodes.title: Advanced Prediction Strategies
nodes.description: Provides diverse strategies for generating predictions, including agentic behaviors, iterative refinement, code execution, and aggregation of multiple outputs.

nodes.label: Retrieval Modules
nodes.title: Information Retrieval Mechanisms
nodes.description: Offers various mechanisms for fetching relevant information from external sources, such as vector databases and specialized search services, to augment LLM responses.

nodes.label: DSP Utilities
nodes.title: Core DSPy Utilities
nodes.description: Contains essential helper functions for text processing (tokenization, answer location), robust configuration management, and efficient loading of background data for various tasks.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: User-Defined DSPy Program
nodes.description: The main DSPy application logic that orchestrates prediction and retrieval operations to solve complex tasks.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: External LLM Service
nodes.description: The underlying large language model that prediction modules interact with to generate responses and perform reasoning.

nodes.label: Vector Database / Index
nodes.title: External Knowledge Source
nodes.description: External systems (e.g., ColBERTv2 index, Databricks Vector Search, Weaviate) that store and provide relevant passages for retrieval.

nodes.label: External Tools / APIs
nodes.title: External Functionality
nodes.description: Various external services or APIs that agentic prediction modules can invoke to perform actions or gather information.

nodes.label: Datasets
nodes.title: Input/Context Data
nodes.description: Collections of examples or background information used as input or context for DSPy programs, often processed by utilities.

groups.label: Core Strategies
groups.title: Prediction & Retrieval Core
groups.description: The central components providing advanced prediction capabilities and mechanisms for fetching relevant information.

groups.label: Supporting Utilities
groups.title: Essential Helper Functions
groups.description: Provides foundational utilities for text processing, configuration management, and data preparation that support prediction and retrieval tasks.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Systems & Data
groups.description: Represents the DSPy program itself and external systems like LLMs, vector databases, tools, and datasets that interact with this module.
